question: The average of three values is 50. First value is 1/2 of the third value. Third value is 30 more than second value. What is the first value?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of three values = 50 × 3 = 150.

Let 1st value = x, then 3rd value = 2x and 2ⁿd value = 2x − 30.

Total sum = x + (2x − 30) + 2x = 5x − 30.

5x − 30 = 150 ⇒ 5x = 180 ⇒ x = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 3 values = 50

1st value = 1/2 × 3rd value

3rd value = 2ⁿd value + 30

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0601b7cef1ffa55429cc23a0e21e58e293a2f788c67a4983fc6cf31fc72cc80a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum = 50 × 3 = 150

⇒ Let the 3rd value be 2x.

⇒ 1st value = 1/2 × 2x = x

⇒ 2ⁿd value = 3rd value − 30 = 2x − 30

⇒ x + (2x − 30) + 2x = 150

⇒ 5x − 30 = 150

⇒ 5x = 180

⇒ x = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

The average (arithmetic mean) is calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total number of observations: Avg = Σx ÷ n.

Total Sum Rule

If the average of n numbers is A, then their sum is always n × A. This is the starting point for most average-based word problems.

Algebraic Translation

When comparing three values, express all unknowns in terms of a single variable (usually the one referenced most) to form a linear equation.
